caption: Figure 1: Graphical models for diffusion (left) and non-Markovian (right) inference models.
description:
## Index Section 1
Graphical models for diffusion and non-Markovian inference. Depicts two models: diffusion model on the left and non-Markovian model on the right. Both models show a sequence of variables \( x_0, x_1, x_2, x_3 \) with arrows indicating dependencies. The diffusion model shows a Markovian process with dependencies \( p_0, q(x_2|x_1), q(x_3|x_2, x_0) \). The non-Markovian model shows dependencies \( q(x_3|x_2, x_0), q(x_2|x_1, x_0) \).

## Index Section 2
Diffusion model: \( x_3 \rightarrow x_2 \rightarrow x_1 \rightarrow x \). Non-Markovian model: \( x_3 \rightarrow x_2 \rightarrow x_1 \rightarrow x_0 \). Variables: \( x_0, x_1, x_2, x_3 \). Dependencies: \( p_0, q(x_2|x_1), q(x_3|x_2, x_0), q(x_3|x_2, x_0), q(x_2|x_1, x_0) \).

caption: Figure 2: Graphical model for accelerated generation, where τ = [1 , 3] .
description:
Section 1: Graphical model for accelerated generation in denoising diffusion implicit models.

Section 2: Figure 2, τ = [1, 3], shows a graphical model for accelerated generation. It depicts nodes labeled x0, x1, x2, x3, and x0, connected by arrows indicating dependencies. Arrows originate from x3 to x2, x2 to x1, and x1 to x0. Additional arrows connect x3 to x1 and x2 to x0. Nodes are labeled with probabilities p0, q(x2|x0), and q(x3|x1, x0).

caption: Figure 4: Hours to sample 50k images with one Nvidia 2080 Ti GPU and samples at different steps.
description:
## Description
This figure contains two plots comparing the time taken to sample 50k images using one Nvidia 2080 Ti GPU for two different models: CIFAR10 and Bedroom. The x-axis represents the number of steps, and the y-axis represents the hours taken. The CIFAR10 plot shows a linear increase in time with the number of steps, starting from 0.2 hours at 10 steps and reaching 20 hours at 1000 steps. The Bedroom plot also shows a linear increase, starting from 10 hours at 10 steps and reaching 1000 hours at 1000 steps.

## Text in figure
CIFAR10:
- Hours: 0.2, 0.5, 2, 5, 20
- Steps: 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000

Bedroom:
- Hours: 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000
- Steps: 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000
